render_rays_nerf: render rays through NeRF models to produce RGB and depth maps with coarse and fine sampling
inference_volume_render: perform NeRF model inference to compute RGB, depth, and sample weights via volume rendering
inference_deform_skinning: run inference with deformation support using flow-based or bone-based skinning for animated NeRF rendering
sample_pdf_importance: sample importance samples from depth bins using a weight-defined probability distribution for NeRF refinement
review_rendering_functions: review the rendering module functions including render_rays, inference, inference_deform, and sample_pdf
